updates.note: Management updated the camera module capacity target to 180 to 190 million units over the next 15 to 18 months.
updates.quote: expanding the capacities of camera module and a subsidiary Q Tech... from 70 million units annually to around 180 million units to 190 million units annually over the next 15 to 18 months

updates.note: Management stated IT hardware revenue in the current fiscal is going to be more than INR4,000 crores.
updates.quote: our revenue in this fiscal is going to be more than INR4,000 crores.

updates.note: FY26 capex was reported around INR1,058 crores.
updates.quote: after doing a capex of almost INR1,058 crores

updates.note: Front-loading washing machine launch confirmed by end of Q2 FY27.
updates.quote: fully automatic front-loading washing machine, which will be launched by end of Q2 this financial year.

new_promises.statement: Telecom segment to achieve INR 7,500 crores to INR 8,000 crores revenue in FY27
new_promises.quote: We are targeting almost INR7,500 crores, INR8,000 crores in '26, '27.
new_promises.speaker: Atul Lall

new_promises.statement: Lighting segment revenue to reach INR 1,700 crores in FY27
new_promises.quote: The next year target is almost INR1,700 crores. We expect 2x after we have formed the JV with Signify.
new_promises.speaker: Atul Lall

new_promises.statement: Camera module business (Q Tech) to target INR 2,500 crores in revenue
new_promises.quote: We are targeting a revenue of almost INR2,500 crores in that business.
new_promises.speaker: Atul Lall

new_promises.statement: Display module JV business to achieve INR 5,500 crores to INR 6,000 crores revenue at peak capacity
new_promises.quote: the revenue generation is going to be almost INR5,500 crores to INR6,000 crores with a double-digit margin.
new_promises.speaker: Atul Lall
